title: Message explorer
unavailable: The live stream is unavailable. Check the MQTT server connection.

dropped.one: {{count}} message was dropped because too many arrived.
dropped.many: {{count}} messages were dropped because too many arrived.

pausedNotice: Paused — the live stream is stopped until you resume; messages sent meanwhile are not shown.
publishHint: Published messages reach the broker like a flow's "send MQTT message" node and can trigger flows.
filterInvalid: Use a valid MQTT topic filter: + and # must fill a whole level, # only at the end, no $share/ or $queue/ prefix (max. 256 bytes).
topicInvalid: Enter a topic without the wildcards + or #.
payloadTooLarge: The payload is too large (max. 256 KiB).
